vectors.description: Inherited properties resolve onto each primitive; group opacity is not inherited and stays on its group.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><g fill="#f00" stroke="#00f" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.5"><g stroke-width="2" fill-rule="evenodd"><path d="M0 0H10V10Z"/><path d="M0 0H5V5Z" fill="none" opacity="0.25"/></g><rect width="4" height="4" stroke="none"/></g></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <g opacity="0.5">
    <g>
      <path d="M 0 0 H 10 V 10 Z" fill="#ff0000" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="#0000ff" stroke-width="2" opacity="1"/>
      <path d="M 0 0 H 5 V 5 Z" fill="none" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="#0000ff" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.25"/>
    </g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="4" height="4" rx="0" ry="0" fill="#ff0000" stroke="none" stroke-width="3" opacity="1"/>
  </g>
</svg>

vectors.description: Inherited properties on the root reach primitives and are not written on the root.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="#123" stroke="#456" stroke-linecap="round" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M0 0H1"/></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <path d="M 0 0 H 1" fill="#112233" stroke="#445566" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: A style declaration overrides the presentation attribute on the same element, and the result inherits.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><g fill="#f00" style="fill:#0f0"><path d="M0 0H1"/><path d="M0 0H2" fill="#00f" style="fill: #fff"/></g></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <g>
    <path d="M 0 0 H 1" fill="#00ff00" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
    <path d="M 0 0 H 2" fill="#ffffff" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
  </g>
</svg>

vectors.description: currentColor resolves to the computed color of each element, including a stop that takes color from its gradient.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="g" color="#ff0"><stop offset="0" stop-color="currentColor"/></linearGradient><g color="#336699"><path d="M0 0H1" fill="currentColor" stroke="currentcolor"/><path d="M0 0H2" style="color: teal" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M0 0H3" stroke="url(#g)"/></g></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="p1" gradientUnits="objectBoundingBox" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%" spreadMethod="pad">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffff00" stop-opacity="1"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <g>
    <path d="M 0 0 H 1" fill="#336699" stroke="#336699" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
    <path d="M 0 0 H 2" fill="#008080" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
    <path d="M 0 0 H 3" fill="#000000" stroke="url(#p1)" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
  </g>
</svg>

vectors.description: Named colors match case-insensitively; rgb() integers and uppercase hexadecimal become lowercase #rrggbb.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M0 0H1" fill="RebeccaPurple" stroke="rgb(0,128 , 255)"/><path d="M0 0H2" fill="#ABCDEF" stroke="#ABC"/></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <path d="M 0 0 H 1" fill="#663399" stroke="#0080ff" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
  <path d="M 0 0 H 2" fill="#abcdef" stroke="#aabbcc" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: currentColor with no color in scope is refused.

transform is an attribute only, never a style declaration.

vectors.description: Opacity outside 0..1 is refused rather than clamped.
Zero dash lengths are admitted; only negative lengths are refused.

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <path d="M 0 0 H 1" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="0 2" opacity="1"/>
</svg>
